name: yrby-forms
description: Collaborative form fields over yrby. The <collaborative-field> custom element binds a plain form control to the document of the <yrby-document> around it. Selects, checkboxes, numbers, and dates are last-write-wins map entries, and text fields merge concurrent typing through Y.Text. A field shows who else has it focused. The yrby-forms Rails gem's form helpers render the elements.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }) + '\n')"
